dct_description_sm: Stream water samples were collected in the 2019 near Expedition Fiord, Axel Heiberg Island, NU in the summer of 2019 in order to investigate dissolved carbon, dissolved ions, and suspended sediment concentrations in snowmelt runoff and glacial meltwater. In 2019, samples were collected from 11 locations within the Wolf River Basin. This study seeks to characterize the concentration of dissolved and suspended material across streams with varying geology and contributions from snow and glacier runoff.
dct_title_s: Dissolved Carbon, ions, and Suspended Material concentrations in snowmelt and glacial meltwater streams at Expedition Fiord, Nunavut, July 2019
